scripts.predeploy: npm run sync:static && node scripts/check-static.mjs && npm run build:library && npm run build:references
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply djopus -c wrangler.chatgpt-legacy-test.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply djopus -c wrangler.chatgpt-legacy-test.toml --local
scripts.predeploy:chatgpt: npm run predeploy && cp client/strudel-ws-bridge-chatgpt.js static/
scripts.predeploy:chatgpt-dev: npm run predeploy && cp client/strudel-ws-bridge-chatgpt.js static/
scripts.pretest: node scripts/ensure-static.mjs && npm run check:library && npm run check:references
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run --if-present test:chatgpt && npm run --if-present test:chatgpt-privacy && vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts && npm run --if-present test:retire
scripts.types: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --strict-vars=false --env-file /dev/null && npm run --if-present types:chatgpt
scripts.types:check: export WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --check && npm run --if-present types:check:chatgpt
scripts.types:check:chatgpt: export WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true && wrangler types src/chatgpt/worker-configuration.d.ts --check -c wrangler.chatgpt-legacy-test.toml --env-interface ChatgptEnv
scripts.typecheck: npm run types:check && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test && npm run --if-present typecheck:chatgpt && npm run --if-present typecheck:retire
